name: Reese
source:
The bossy Assistant Manager, Reese, always has something to prove. Can you break through to his gentle side and help him achieve something that’s always been out of his grasp?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datenighto/hustle-cat-a-visual-novel-about-a-magical-cat-cafe]Kickstarter[/url]]

[spoiler]Reese has been practicing magic his entire life and has always known he is a witch. He practices drawing magic even though he isn't good at it. He actually has transportation magic where he cuts a seam into the air, opening up a portal, and he can bewitch clothing. Both of his abilities are related to sewing[/spoiler]
